head: Platen typewriter app for iPhone brings paper, ink and key sounds
dek: Platen — Paper & Ink is a writing app that makes your iPhone feel like a typewriter, with textured paper, uneven ink and mechanical sounds. It was #77 in Productivity on the US App Store's free chart on 15 November.
details: You pick the paper, type size, margins and ink darkness, and corrections can stay as crossed-out letters. Notes can be searched, backed up or synced with iCloud, and each holds up to 3,000 characters. The free version allows three active notes; Platen Studio is a one-time purchase with more notes, paper and sounds, and there's no subscription. Its latest update added iPad support; it's made by Rafikki Studio.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, free with one-time purchases
means: If a blank notes app doesn't make you want to write, this gives letters and journal entries a slower, typewriter feel.
todo: Try the three free notes first; the 3,000-character limit per note makes it better for letters than long drafts.
